# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: SOV 1970 scripted effects — scripted effects.
## COLDWAR | Cold War mod (MD Imperia) - Soviet Union 1970
## Generated by the COLDWAR Soviet generator (Claude outputs/COLDWAR_SOV_generator) from the approved design
## (project doc claude/mdcw_sov_1970_focus_tree_design.md). Edit the generator, not this file.
## Search for 'COLDWAR' to find every Cold War addition.

COLDWAR_SOV_initialize_1970 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_initialized
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_bre
		# laws, internal factions and the seven starting spirits
		add_ideas = {
			bureau_04
			defence_07
			police_04
			edu_04
			health_03
			social_04
			draft_army
			intervention_global_interventionism
			officer_military_academy
			md_closed_economy
			comprehensive_regulations
			fully_nationalized_healthcare
			economic_motivated_mining
			censored_nation_05
			communist_cadres
			the_military
			intelligence_community
			defense_industry
			industrial_conglomerates
			farmers
			labour_unions
			COLDWAR_SOV_stability_of_cadres
			COLDWAR_SOV_burden_of_parity
			COLDWAR_SOV_agrarian_problem
			COLDWAR_SOV_ussuri_frontier
			COLDWAR_SOV_shadow_of_prague
			COLDWAR_SOV_second_economy
			COLDWAR_SOV_dissent
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { communist_cadres_opinion = 75 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { the_military_opinion = 70 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { intelligence_community_opinion = 70 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { defense_industry_opinion = 80 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { industrial_conglomerates_opinion = 60 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { farmers_opinion = 45 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { labour_unions_opinion = 55 } }
		initialize_internal_faction_dynamic_modifiers = yes
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion = 62 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop = 0.15 } }
		set_power_balance = { id = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop left_side = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop_left_side right_side = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop_right_side set_value = 0.15 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_armed_forces_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.05 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_commonwealth_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = -0.03 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_commonwealth_oil_export_multiplier_modifier = -0.1 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_commonwealth_mdcw_cw_support_effectiveness = 0.1 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_commonwealth_opinion_gain_monthly_same_ideology_factor = 0.1 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_commonwealth_foreign_influence_modifier = 0.05 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_unbreakable }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_strained }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_crisis }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_disintegration }
	}
}

# called once from on_startup (all countries exist by then)
COLDWAR_SOV_setup_politburo = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_system } }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_system
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_seat_count = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 8 } }			# the VIII Five-Year Plan (1966-1970) is running
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_session_half = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_congress = 23 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UKR UKR = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } } UKR = { COLDWAR_SOV_take_seat = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = KAZ KAZ = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } } KAZ = { COLDWAR_SOV_take_seat = yes } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.10 days = 181 }
	}
	# the Politburo dossier (cw_pbgui.py): seats and Socialist Emulation, also for an older save
	COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_seats = yes
	COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_board = yes
}

# ---- money as a share of GDP (temp COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share, positive) ----------------------------
COLDWAR_SOV_pay_gdp_share = {
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
}

COLDWAR_SOV_receive_gdp_share = {
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_last_transfer = treasury_change } }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
}

# the Soviet Union (THIS) pays a share of its GDP to the country in temp COLDWAR_SOV_transfer_target
COLDWAR_SOV_transfer_gdp_share = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_amount = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_amount = COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SOV_amount }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	var:COLDWAR_SOV_transfer_target = {
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SOV_amount }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
}

# monthly (on_monthly_SOV): the Mongolian garrison (0.2% of GDP a year) and the Afghan Burden (0.3% of GDP a month)
COLDWAR_SOV_monthly_aid = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = MON MON = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_garrison_host } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_transfer_target = MON.id }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.000167 }
		COLDWAR_SOV_transfer_gdp_share = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_afghan_burden }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.003 }
		COLDWAR_SOV_pay_gdp_share = yes
	}
}

# monthly: The Comprehensive Programme refunds 25 PP of the Cold War decision "Comecon Integration Programme"
# (read-only on the Cold War system: its programme flag global.mdcw_cw_bp_2 runs 730 days)
COLDWAR_SOV_monthly_comecon_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_comprehensive_programme
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_bp_2
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_comecon_refunded }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOV_comecon_refunded days = 730 }
		add_political_power = 25
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_change_debt_gdp_share = {
	set_temp_variable = { debt_change = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { debt_change = COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share }
	modify_debt_effect = yes
}

# ---- internal factions: exact values (MD doubles positive gains for autocracies) ----------------
COLDWAR_SOV_prepare_exact_opinion = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_requested_opinion = temp_opinion }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { temp_opinion > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 7 }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 13 }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			}
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 0.5 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_restore_exact_opinion = {
	set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = COLDWAR_SOV_requested_opinion }
}

COLDWAR_SOV_change_communist_cadres_opinion_exact = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = communist_cadres }
		COLDWAR_SOV_prepare_exact_opinion = yes
		change_communist_cadres_opinion = yes
		COLDWAR_SOV_restore_exact_opinion = yes
	}
}

# ---- outlook popularity: the ruling party if it belongs to the outlook, otherwise the outlook's main Soviet party
COLDWAR_SOV_change_outlook_popularity = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_outlook_id = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > -1 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_outlook_id = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > 3 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 10 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 4 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_outlook_id = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > 9 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 12 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 10 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_outlook_id = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > 11 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 20 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 13 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_outlook_id = 4 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > 19 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 24 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 20 } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = COLDWAR_SOV_outlook_amount }
	set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = COLDWAR_SOV_outlook_amount }
	change_relative_party_popularity = yes
}


# ---- Union cohesion (0-100, SOV scope; temp COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta) ------------------------
COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { original_tag = SOV } }
		SOV = { COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion = COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion_tt }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion min = 0 max = 100 } }
		hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
	}
}

# monthly (on_monthly_SOV): -1 low stability, -1 losing war, -1 deep corruption, +1 high stability
COLDWAR_SOV_monthly_cohesion = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_stability < 0.4 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_war = yes surrender_progress > 0.1 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_idea = corruption_level_07 has_idea = corruption_level_08 has_idea = corruption_level_09 has_idea = corruption_level_10 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_stability > 0.7 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = 1 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion = COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion min = 0 max = 100 } }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# ---- Politburo balance: the shadow variable COLDWAR_SOV_bop mirrors the balance of power -------
COLDWAR_SOV_monthly_bop_drift = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop > 0.01 } }
		add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop value = -0.01 }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop = -0.01 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop < -0.01 } }
		add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop value = 0.01 }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop = 0.01 } }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_bop_toward_centre_10 = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_bop_centre_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop > 0.1 } } add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop value = -0.1 tooltip_side = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop_left_side } hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop = -0.1 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_bop min = -1 max = 1 } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop < -0.1 } } add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop value = 0.1 tooltip_side = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop_right_side } hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop = 0.1 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_bop min = -1 max = 1 } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop > 0.04 } } add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop value = -0.05 tooltip_side = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop_left_side } hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop = -0.05 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_bop min = -1 max = 1 } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop < -0.04 } } add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop value = 0.05 tooltip_side = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop_right_side } hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop = 0.05 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_bop min = -1 max = 1 } } } }
	}
}

# ---- elections ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COLDWAR_SOV_allow_elections = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_allow_elections_tt
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { disable_elections = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = yes } }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_suspend_elections = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_suspend_elections_tt
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { disable_elections = 1 } }
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = no } }
	}
}

# ==== General Secretaries ========================================================================
COLDWAR_SOV_clear_gensec = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_kos
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_pod
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_sus
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_she
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_and
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_gre
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_ust
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_gro
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_che
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_gor
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_bre
	# MDCW HP SOV PENDING CLEAR BEGIN
	MDCW_HP_SOV_clear_manual_retirement_pending = yes
	# MDCW HP SOV PENDING CLEAR END
}

COLDWAR_SOV_clear_heirs = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_kos
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_pod
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_sus
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_she
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_and
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_gre
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_ust
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_gro
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_che
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_gor
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_bre
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_aliyev
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_grishin
}

COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_kos = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_clear_gensec = yes
	COLDWAR_SOV_clear_heirs = yes
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bre_retiring
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_kos
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_standin_kos = yes } custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_install_kos_standin_tt }
	else = { custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_install_kos_tt }
	hidden_effect = {
		retire_country_leader = yes
		if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_standin_kos = yes }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Nikolai Ryzhkov" picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SOV_nikolai_ryzhkov.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_SOV_economist_premier } }
		}
		else = {
			create_country_leader = { name = "Alexei Kosygin" picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SOV_alexei_kosygin.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_SOV_economist_premier } }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.33 hours = 6 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_set_heir_kos = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_clear_heirs = yes
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_kos
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_kos_tt
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bre_retiring } hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.32 days = 7 } } }
}

COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_pod = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_clear_gensec = yes
	COLDWAR_SOV_clear_heirs = yes
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bre_retiring
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_pod

	hidden_effect = {
		retire_country_leader = yes
		if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_standin_pod = yes }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Vasily Kuznetsov" picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SOV_vasily_kuznetsov.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_SOV_head_of_state } }
		}
		else = {
			create_country_leader = { name = "Nikolai Podgorny" picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SOV_nikolai_podgorny.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_SOV_head_of_state } }

	}
	# MDCW HP SOV DIRECT HEIR CLEAR COLDWAR_SOV_heir_takes_over_aliyev BEGIN
	MDCW_HP_SOV_clear_manual_retirement_pending = yes
	# MDCW HP SOV DIRECT HEIR CLEAR COLDWAR_SOV_heir_takes_over_aliyev END
}

# the designated heir is put to the Politburo first; otherwise the succession plenum chooses among the living
COLDWAR_SOV_succession = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_aliyev has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_and }
		COLDWAR_SOV_heir_takes_over_aliyev = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_grishin has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_che }
		COLDWAR_SOV_heir_takes_over_grishin = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_kos  }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_kos = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_pod  }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_pod = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_sus  }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_sus = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_she always = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_she = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_and  }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_and = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_gre  }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_gre = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_ust  }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 7 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_ust = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_gro always = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 8 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_gro = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_che  }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 9 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_che = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_heir_gor always = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 10 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running }
			COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_gor = yes
		}
		else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_restore_party_rule = {
	set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 4 }
	change_ruling_party_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { date < 1982.11.10 NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_dead_bre } }
		COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_bre = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date < 1984.2.9 }
		COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_and = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date < 1985.3.10 }
		COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_che = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_gor = yes
	}
}

# ==== The Politburo and the Republics: three seats, votes, proposals, intrigue ====================
COLDWAR_SOV_take_seat = {
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_seat
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_seat_count = 1 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bid = 0 } }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_applied
	COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_seats = yes
}

# THIS = republic, ROOT/FROM = Moscow
COLDWAR_SOV_grant_seat = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_take_seat = yes
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat_changed_this_congress
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = 1 }
	SOV = { COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes }
	COLDWAR_SOV_mark_last_seat = yes
}

COLDWAR_SOV_leave_seat = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_seat
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_seat_count = -1 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = global.COLDWAR_SOV_seat_count min = 0 max = 3 } }
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat_changed_this_congress
	COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_seats = yes
}

COLDWAR_SOV_dismiss_seat = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_leave_seat = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -2 }
	SOV = { COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes }
	COLDWAR_SOV_mark_last_seat = yes
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.27 hours = 6 }
}

COLDWAR_SOV_mark_last_seat = {
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_seat } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_seat }
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_seat
}

# temp in: COLDWAR_SOV_vt type (1 resolution, 2 plan, 3 leadership, 4 proposal, 5 cadre question of the Union plan), _vl lean (-1/0/1),
# _vs subject, _vu Union question
COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = COLDWAR_SOV_vt } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_lean = COLDWAR_SOV_vl } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = COLDWAR_SOV_vs } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_union = COLDWAR_SOV_vu } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_yes = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_total = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_cast = 0 } }
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_in_vote } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_in_vote }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_in_vote
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_yes
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_no
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_abstain
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_pending
		COLDWAR_SOV_vote_weight = yes
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_total = COLDWAR_SOV_w } }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } COLDWAR_SOV_ai_ballot = yes }
		else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.11 } }
	}
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.12 days = 10 }
}

# an AI seat holder votes at once: always in favour of a change of leadership (Enes, 18.10.2026); against the replacement of its own
# First Secretary; otherwise mostly in favour
COLDWAR_SOV_ai_ballot = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_ballot = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_cadre_target } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_ballot = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 5 } } random_list = { 67 = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_ballot = 1 } } 33 = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_ballot = 2 } } } }
	else = { random_list = { 91 = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_ballot = 1 } } 9 = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_ballot = 2 } } } }
	COLDWAR_SOV_cast_vote = yes
}

COLDWAR_SOV_vote_weight = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_w = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_union = 1 } SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_federal_union } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_w = 2 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_cast_vote = {   # temp COLDWAR_SOV_ballot: 1 yes, 2 no, 0 abstain
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_pending }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_pending
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_ballot = 1 } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_yes
			COLDWAR_SOV_vote_weight = yes
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_yes = COLDWAR_SOV_w } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_cast = COLDWAR_SOV_w } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_ballot = 2 } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_no COLDWAR_SOV_vote_weight = yes hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_cast = COLDWAR_SOV_w } } }
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_abstain }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_tally_vote = {
	# the seven Moscow members follow the Politburo balance; republican proposals always get three of them.
	# A change of leadership (type 3, Enes 18.10.2026): Moscow casts 3 votes in favour, no simulated members, no extra GS vote.
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_t0 = 8 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_m = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_g = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_m = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_g = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_t0 = 3 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_m = COLDWAR_SOV_bop }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_m = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_lean }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_m = 3.5 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_m = 3.5 }
		round_temp_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_m
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_m min = 0 max = 7 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_g = 1 }
	}
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_moscow = COLDWAR_SOV_m } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_yes = COLDWAR_SOV_m } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_yes = COLDWAR_SOV_g } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_yes = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_yes } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_total = COLDWAR_SOV_t0 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_total = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_total } }
	# a change of leadership counts only the votes cast: abstentions do not help to reject Moscow's candidate (all three seats must vote no)
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 3 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_total = COLDWAR_SOV_t0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_total = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_rep_cast } } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_no = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_total } }
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_no = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_yes } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_t = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_yes }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_t = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_t > global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_total } }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed
	}
	else = { clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_pending }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_pending
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_abstain
	}
	# the news and the follow-up events read the 'last' copies, so a new vote cannot overwrite what they show
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_last_type = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_last_subject = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_last_succession = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_passed } else = { clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_passed }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 4 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_last_proposer = global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_proposer } }
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_proposer } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_proposer }
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_current_proposer } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_proposer }
	}
	every_country = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_no has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_abstain } }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_yes clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_no clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_abstain
	}
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_in_vote }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_yes } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_no } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_no }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_voted_abstain } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_last_abstain }
	}
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.13 hours = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
			add_political_power = 25
			add_stability = 0.02
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_defying_the_politburo days = 180 }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -2 }
			COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
			add_political_power = 50
		}
		else = { add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_defying_the_politburo days = 180 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_kos = yes
				}
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_success_kos = yes
				}
				else = { COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_failure_kos = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_pod = yes
				}
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_success_pod = yes
				}
				else = { COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_failure_pod = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_sus = yes
				}
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_success_sus = yes
				}
				else = { COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_failure_sus = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 4 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_she = yes
				}
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_success_she = yes
				}
				else = { COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_failure_she = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_and = yes
				}
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 } }
			}
			else = {

					COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_success_and = yes

			if = {

					COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_gre = yes
				}
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 } }

					COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_success_gre = yes
				}

			}

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_ust = yes
				}
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 } }

					COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_success_ust = yes
				}
				else = { COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_failure_ust = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 8 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
					COLDWAR_SOV_install_gensec_gro = yes
				}
				else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.31 days = 1 } }

					COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_success_gor = yes
				}
				else = { COLDWAR_SOV_plenum_failure_gor = yes }
			}
		}
		# MDCW HP SOV VOTE RETIREMENT HANDOFF BEGIN
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 3 } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 1 } NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } has_country_flag = MDCW_HP_SOV_manual_retirement_pending }
			set_country_flag = MDCW_HP_SOV_manual_retirement_choice_pending
		}
		MDCW_HP_SOV_clear_manual_retirement_request = yes
		# MDCW HP SOV VOTE RETIREMENT HANDOFF END
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_succession = 0 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_tp = global.COLDWAR_SOV_last_proposer }
		var:COLDWAR_SOV_tp = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_proposal_rejected
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_proposal_locked }
		}

			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.22 days = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_ct = global.COLDWAR_UNI_cadre_target }
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_cadre } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_cadre }
		var:COLDWAR_UNI_ct = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_cadre clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_cadre_target }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop value = 0.05 tooltip_side = COLDWAR_SOV_politburo_bop_right_side }
			hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_bop = 0.05 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_bop min = -1 max = 1 } } }
			var:COLDWAR_UNI_ct = { if = { limit = { COLDWAR_UNI_is_republic = yes } COLDWAR_UNI_replace_first_secretary = yes } }
		}
	}
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running
	# the next resolution in the queue waits three days, so everyone can read the result
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.55 days = 3 }
}

# Politburo resolutions on key foci (temp COLDWAR_SOV_queue_subject)
COLDWAR_SOV_queue_resolution = {
	add_to_array = { array = global.COLDWAR_SOV_res_queue value = COLDWAR_SOV_queue_subject }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_running } } COLDWAR_SOV_next_queued_vote = yes }
}

COLDWAR_SOV_next_queued_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_res_queue^num > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = global.COLDWAR_SOV_res_queue^0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.COLDWAR_SOV_res_queue value = COLDWAR_SOV_q }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = COLDWAR_SOV_q }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 6 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 7 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 8 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 9 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 10 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 11 } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 8 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 9 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 10 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_q = 11 } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes
	}
}

# THIS = the republic that gets the building; Moscow pays a share of its GDP:
# base share x (1 + 0.5 x Union projects still weighing on Moscow's budget), and takes on one more burden
COLDWAR_SOV_build_union_project = {
	SOV = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_burden_now = COLDWAR_SOV_republic_burden } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_burden_mult = COLDWAR_SOV_burden_now }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_burden_mult = 0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_burden_mult = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_building = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 1 }
		one_random_industrial_complex = yes
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.02 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_building = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 1 }
		one_random_infrastructure = yes
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.015 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_building = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 1 }
		one_random_fossil_fuel_powerplant = yes
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.02 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_building = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 1 }
		one_random_agriculture_district = yes
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.015 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_building = 5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 1 }
		one_random_arms_factory = yes
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.03 }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = COLDWAR_SOV_burden_mult }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_price_pct = COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_price_pct = 100 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_union_project_cost_tt
	SOV = { COLDWAR_SOV_pay_gdp_share = yes COLDWAR_SOV_add_republic_burden = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = 1 }
	SOV = { COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes }
}

# THIS = SOV: one more Union project weighs on the budget for 90 days (event COLDWAR_SOV.30 lifts it again)
COLDWAR_SOV_add_republic_burden = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_republic_burden_tt
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_republic_burden = 1 } }
	COLDWAR_SOV_update_republic_burden = yes
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.30 days = 90 } }
}

# THIS = SOV: Tax Cost Factor (Consumer Goods) +10% per active burden; the modifier goes away at zero
COLDWAR_SOV_update_republic_burden = {
	hidden_effect = {
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_republic_burden min = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_republic_investment_consumer_goods_factor = COLDWAR_SOV_republic_burden } }
		hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_republic_investment_consumer_goods_factor = 0.1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_republic_burden > 0 } NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_republic_investment_modifier } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_republic_investment_modifier }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_republic_burden < 1 } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_republic_investment_modifier } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_republic_investment_modifier }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

# THIS = proposing republic (variables COLDWAR_SOV_prop_type / _prop_building / _prop_benef)
COLDWAR_SOV_execute_proposal = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_type = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_building = COLDWAR_SOV_prop_building }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_prop_benef NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_benef = THIS.id } } }
			var:COLDWAR_SOV_prop_benef = { COLDWAR_SOV_build_union_project = yes }
		}
		else = { COLDWAR_SOV_build_union_project = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_type = 2 } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_relief days = 730 }
		SOV = { add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_shortfall days = 730 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_type = 3 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_cadre_protection
	}
	clear_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_prop_benef
}

# the chance that an investigation finds something (THIS = the republic; temp COLDWAR_SOV_chance, 0-90).
# Also used by the January audit of the Union plan (cw_union): Moscow's Man is immune, Keep Reserves in Hand -10.
COLDWAR_SOV_investigation_chance = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_cadre_protection has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 15 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_01 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_02 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_03 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_04 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 20 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_05 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 25 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_06 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 30 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_07 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 35 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_08 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 40 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_09 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 45 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = corruption_level_10 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 50 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pripiski } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 25 } }
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_discipline_campaign } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 20 } }
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_local_barons } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = -10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_reserves } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = -10 } }
		# Socialist Emulation (cw_emulation.py): Gosplan reads the figures of the last republic twice
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_lagging_behind } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_chance = 10 } }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_chance min = 0 max = 90 }
	}
}

# kompromat against a seat holder (THIS = the accused republic)
COLDWAR_SOV_investigate_republic = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_investigation_chance = yes
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_SOV_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_accused } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_accused }
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_accused
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_roll < COLDWAR_SOV_chance } }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat_proven
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } COLDWAR_SOV_leave_seat = yes }
		# a false Union plan report is uncovered with it (cw_union): reward gone, double shortfall, Moscow judges
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_reported_false } COLDWAR_UNI_pripiski_exposed = yes }
		# false figures in the Socialist Emulation are uncovered with it (cw_emulation.py)
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pripiski has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_inflated } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualified } } COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualify = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_disgrace_left = 2 } }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pripiski
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -1 }
		SOV = { COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.35 days = 3 }
	}
	else = { clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat_proven }
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.18 hours = 6 }
}

COLDWAR_SOV_federation_council = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_federation_council_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_federation_council
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat }
			COLDWAR_SOV_leave_seat = yes
		}
		news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.28 hours = 6 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_withdraw_from_afghanistan = {
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_afghan_burden
	if = { limit = { country_exists = AFG } AFG = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.49 days = 1 } } }
}

# a new Five-Year Plan begins (from the session event): the old priority ends, every seat holder chooses a Union project
COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_group_a } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_group_a }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_group_b } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_group_b }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_armaments } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_armaments }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_agriculture } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_agriculture }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_priority_chosen
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.25 days = 1 }
	}
}

# a seat holder takes its rejected proposal before the Politburo (THIS = the republic)
COLDWAR_SOV_propose_to_politburo = {
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_current_proposer } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_current_proposer }
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_current_proposer
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_proposer = THIS.id } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 4 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_type = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = COLDWAR_SOV_prop_building } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_prop_type = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 6 } }
	else = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = 7 } }
	SOV = { COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes }
}

# ==== the Politburo dossier (decision category GUI, cw_pbgui.py) =================================
# the three seats keep their place in the dossier: a member who leaves frees his slot, a new member takes the first free one
COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_seats = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_country = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } } clear_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot }
		set_temp_variable = { pb_o1 = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pb_o2 = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pb_o3 = 0 }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_1_on = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_1 = SOV } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_2_on = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_2 = SOV } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_3_on = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_3 = SOV } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_1 = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_1_on = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pb_o1 = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_2 = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_2_on = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pb_o2 = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot = 3 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_3 = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_3_on = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pb_o3 = 1 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pb_o1 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_1 = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_1_on = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pb_o1 = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { pb_o2 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_2 = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_2_on = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pb_o2 = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { pb_o3 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot = 3 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_seat_3 = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_slot_3_on = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pb_o3 = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

# ==== Socialist Emulation (cw_emulation.py) ======================================================
# the monthly table: Moscow ranks the republics by the figures they report (THIS = any scope;
# temp COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan = the Five-Year Plan whose targets count, the running one unless the January judgement passes another)
COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_board = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan = global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_ssr_count = 0 } }
		# a republic that has left the Union leaves the table
		every_country = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_growth NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } } clear_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_growth clear_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_industry clear_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_output clear_variable = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_plan }
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_ssr_count = 1 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_growth = last_quarter_gdp_growth_rate } }
			hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_growth = 100 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_industry = industrial_complex_total } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_industry = military_factory_total } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_output = gdp_per_capita } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_plan = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_fp_plan = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_plan = COLDWAR_UNI_fulfilled_plan } } }
			# pripiski: the republic's statisticians polish the figures Moscow reads - only the republic itself knows
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_inflated }
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_growth = 1.5 } }
				hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_industry = 1.1 } }
				hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_output = 1.1 } }
			}
			# disqualified for false figures: last in every column
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualified }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_growth = -1000 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_industry = -1000 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_output = -1000 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_plan = -1000 } }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_growth_val = -1000 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_growth = SOV } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { pb_my = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_growth }
			set_temp_variable = { pb_rank = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_growth > pb_my } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pb_rank = 1 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_growth = pb_rank } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_growth = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_growth = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_growth_val = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_growth } } }
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_industry_val = -1000 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_industry = SOV } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { pb_my = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_industry }
			set_temp_variable = { pb_rank = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_industry > pb_my } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pb_rank = 1 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_industry = pb_rank } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_industry = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_industry = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_industry_val = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_industry } } }
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_output_val = -1000 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_output = SOV } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { pb_my = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_output }
			set_temp_variable = { pb_rank = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_output > pb_my } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pb_rank = 1 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_output = pb_rank } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_output = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_output = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_output_val = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_output } } }
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_plan_val = -1000 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_plan = SOV } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { pb_my = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_plan }
			set_temp_variable = { pb_rank = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_plan > pb_my } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pb_rank = 1 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_plan = pb_rank } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_plan = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_plan = THIS } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_plan_val = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_v_plan } } }
		}
	}
}

# on_monthly_SOV: the dossier, the table, and every third month the Red Banners
COLDWAR_SOV_pb_monthly = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_seats = yes
	COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_board = yes
	hidden_effect = {
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_month = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_q = global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_month }
		modulo_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_q = 3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_q = 0 } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_ssr_count > 1 } } COLDWAR_SOV_pb_award_banners = yes }
	}
}

# every quarter (SOV scope): each banner goes to the leader of its column; the holder keeps it on a tie, nobody wins it with nothing
COLDWAR_SOV_pb_award_banners = {
	hidden_effect = {
		# Growth
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_growth NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.166 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_growth_val > 0 }
				NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_growth COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_growth = 1 } } }
			}
			every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_growth COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.166 } }
			var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_growth = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.162 } }
		}
		# Industry
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_industry NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.167 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_industry_val > 0 }
				NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_industry COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_industry = 1 } } }
			}
			every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_industry COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.167 } }
			var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_industry = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.163 } }
		}
		# Output per Head
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_output NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.168 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_output_val > 0 }
				NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_output COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_output = 1 } } }
			}
			every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_output COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.168 } }
			var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_output = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.164 } }
		}
		# the Plan
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_plan NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.169 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_plan_val > 0 }
				NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_plan COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_plan = 1 } } }
			}
			every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_plan COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.169 } }
			var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_top_plan = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.165 } }
		}
		# the Socialist Emulation focus (Union tree) doubles the banners: a holder from before the focus carries the new rank from this quarter
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_emulation }
			every_country = {
				limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_growth NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_banner_growth_2 } } AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_industry NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_banner_industry_2 } } AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_output NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_banner_output_2 } } AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_banner_plan NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_banner_plan_2 } } } }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.179 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# the January session (SOV scope): the past year is judged by the sum of the four ranks; Moscow's favourite counts 3 places better, a disqualified republic cannot win
COLDWAR_SOV_pb_award_pride = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan = 8 }
	if = { limit = { date > 1971.6.1 } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan = 9 } }
	if = { limit = { date > 1976.6.1 } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { date > 1981.6.1 } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan = 11 } }
	if = { limit = { date > 1986.6.1 } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan = 12 } }
	COLDWAR_SOV_pb_update_board = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_ssr_count > 1 } }
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_order_new
			clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_lagging_named
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_best = 1000 }
			every_country = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_growth } }
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_industry } }
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_output } }
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_rank_plan } }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_favoured } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score = -3 } } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualified } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score < COLDWAR_SOV_pb_best } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_best = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_pride = THIS } } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_best < 1000 } }
				# a title in a row: last January's winner defends it
				var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_pride = {
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_new_pride
					if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_won_last } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_streak = 1 } } }
					else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_streak = 1 } } }
				}
				every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_won_last } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_won_last }
				var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_pride = {
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_won_last
					# three titles in one Five-Year Plan: the Order of Lenin
					if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_title_plan = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_title_plan = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_judge_plan } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_titles = 0 } } }
					hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_titles = 1 } }
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_titles > 2 } NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_order_of_lenin } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_order_due set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_order_new }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.160 }
				}
				set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_pride_awarded
				# the last place: not the winner, not Moscow's favourite, not a republic already disqualified
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_worst = -1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_ssr_count > 2 } }
					every_country = {
						limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_new_pride } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_favoured } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualified } }
						if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score > COLDWAR_SOV_pb_worst } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_worst = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_score } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_lagging = THIS } } }
					}
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_worst > -1 } } set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_lagging_named var:global.COLDWAR_SOV_pb_lagging = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.161 } } }
				}
				every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_new_pride } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_new_pride }
				every_country = {
					limit = { OR = { original_tag = SOV COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes } }
					news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.38 hours = 12 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# THIS = the winner of the January judgement (event COLDWAR_SOV.160)
COLDWAR_SOV_pb_receive_pride = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_pb_streak > 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_pride_of_the_union } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_pride_of_the_union }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_hero_of_socialist_labour } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_hero_of_socialist_labour } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_hero_of_socialist_labour days = 365 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_leader_with_trait = COLDWAR_SOV_gold_star } } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_SOV_gold_star }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_hero_of_socialist_labour } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_hero_of_socialist_labour }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_pride_of_the_union } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_pride_of_the_union } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_pride_of_the_union days = 365 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_order_due } hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_order_due } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_order_of_lenin }
}

# THIS = a republic whose false figures are uncovered (COLDWAR_UNI_pripiski_exposed, COLDWAR_SOV_investigate_republic)
COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualify = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualified_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_inflated
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualified days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.178 }
	}
}
